title: Throne of Glass Memory Atlas
subtitle: A TriMemory-inspired demo that maps reading order, story chronology, and semantic structure into one interactive 3D graph.

source.author: Sarah J. Maas
source.scope: Curated dummy data spanning Endovier, the Champion competition, Nehemia's alliance, Elena's warnings, and the final Cain duel.

dimensions.x: System time: when the reading agent learned the memory while progressing through the book.
dimensions.y: Memory band: Episode, Event, Fact, Pattern, Principle, plus the cross-cutting Entity band.
dimensions.z: Story-valid time: when the memory is true inside the novel's chronology.

featured_entities.name: Celaena Sardothien
featured_entities.focus: Best node for tracing status revisions, provenance, and cross-layer participation.

featured_entities.name: Chaol Westfall
featured_entities.focus: Shows the relational shift from captor to trainer to protector.

featured_entities.name: Nehemia Ytger
featured_entities.focus: Highlights how friendship and politics reshape higher-order patterns.

featured_entities.name: Duke Perrington
featured_entities.focus: Connects the corruption, sponsorship, and forbidden-magic threads.
